description: Split from T-018 on 2026-10-02. The T-016 spike found Workflows aren't available in Workers for Platforms, so Worker-script sites can't bind one, and the container Worker exports no WorkflowEntrypoint, so the kind stays in HIDDEN_FROM_BUILDER. A container version would export a generic dply WorkflowEntrypoint from the container Worker whose steps call the app (e.g. POST /_dply/workflow/{name}/{step} through the agent or the app), with the workflow's class name stored on the connection. Needs an owner call on whether it's worth building.
title: Workflows for container apps
